status: method frozen after T3 design and before RealSense evaluation on T1, T4, T5, or T6
claim_boundary: This source validation tests a causal RealSense-guarded state update on development objects. It is not confirmation, not a target-object result, and not evidence that Kinect and RealSense errors are statistically independent.

sensor_roles.primary_predictor: released Kinect point-cloud checkpoint using Kinect cameras 0 and 1
sensor_roles.candidate_observation: Kinect graph registration through frame f-1
sensor_roles.independent_anchor_family: RealSense D405 depth cameras 0 and 1 mounted eye-in-hand
sensor_roles.intervention_evidence: measured force-torque and T_WT/T_WE robot transforms through frame f-1

method_lock.failed_sensor_policy: exclude that sensor before regret aggregation; use exact checkpoint fallback if none remain
method_lock.unknown_cross_camera_correlation_rule: maximum regret over calibration-qualified RealSense sensors
method_lock.selector_timing: regret measured at frame f-1 selects the same named candidate arm for frame f

source_validation.aggregation: equal mean over objects after equal mean over takes and active target frames

prospective_T2_gate.decision_if_failed: publish the source/T2 result and keep calibration and target objects sealed

forbidden: changing the 15 mm support radius after inspecting a source-validation outcome
extracting or listing T2, calibration-object, or target-object payload members before their registered stage
using RealSense frame f to select a prediction for frame f
using target-mesh error as perception reliability or a candidate-selection feature
treating the two eye-in-hand cameras as independent sample-size evidence
opening T2 unless every source-validation gate passes
calling source validation a state-of-the-art result
